'''Sheed''' was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who joined the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], he tasked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with recovering supplies stolen by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
